home.practice_reactor_blurb: Swipe the core to fuse fuel rods, then push each hot rod out through an open port before the core goes critical.
reactor.title: Reactor
reactor.how_to: Swipe anywhere to slide every rod that way. Two rods of one grade that meet fuse into the next grade. After each swipe a new rod comes in on the edge the rods slid away from. A grade IV rod is hot: it fuses with nothing. Swipe it against the wall where a port is open and it is discharged for the big score; that port closes and another opens. Four hot rods in the core at once and it scrams.
reactor.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD swipe the core.
reactor.salvo_note: Hot rods lined up nose to tail at a port all go out in one swipe: two score two and a half times what they would apart, three score four times.
reactor.pipeline_note: Discharge again within eight swipes and the pipeline builds, up to double. The bar under the core counts the swipes you have left.
reactor.hint_note: Practice rounds point the way when a swipe would discharge a rod and you pause.
reactor.legend_hot: Hot rod. Fuses with nothing. Push it out through a port.
reactor.legend_port_idle: An open port. The faint band is the lane it serves.
reactor.legend_port_ready: Chevrons: a hot rod is at the front of the lane. Swipe that way.
reactor.legend_port_blocked: A bar: a hot rod is in the lane with another rod in its way.
reactor.legend_heat: The lamps over the core count hot rods. Light the diamond and the core scrams: it is emptied and you lose 150.
harness.preset.reactor_quick_rods: Grade III is hot: rods cook fast
harness.preset.reactor_no_holding: No holding: a second hot rod scrams the core
